Contact Center AI Contact center AI: the patented engine that turns performance, interaction, and customer data into predictions, next best actions, and automation for frontline teams. 
 Contact Center AI 
Capability
What it does 
Next Best Action AI
Patented AI weighs an agent's scorecard gaps against business priorities and picks the coaching action most likely to move performance each cycle, alongside the follow-up and recognition tasks AmplifAI generates.
High Performer Persona Modeling
Builds profiles from top performer behaviors and outcomes, identifying gaps across the team to replicate what works.
Auto QA Scoring on Your Own Form
AmplifAI scores calls, chats, and emails against your QA forms, question by question, providing reasons and conversation moments supporting the answers across the interaction volume you choose, up to 100% coverage.
Predictive NPS
AmplifAI predicts NPS for individual interactions using conversation behavior, sentiment, and outcome data, without requiring a customer survey.
Predictive CSAT
AmplifAI predicts CSAT for individual interactions from conversation data without requiring a customer survey, then compares predicted scores with returned surveys.
AI Coaching Simulation
Max, AmplifAI’s AI coaching simulation, leads scheduled or on-demand sessions that review agent KPIs and recent calls, replay moments where an agent missed a behavior, compare those moments with top-performer examples from a matching call type, and role-play an improved approach. Max sends supervisors a session summary and feeds the results into performance tracking.
DeepQuery IQ
Search your contact center's transcripts in your own words, by keyword or by describing a moment in plain language, then save, filter and export the moments you find and read the full conversations behind them.
Knowledge Base and CRM Checks
Auto QA checks process questions against the knowledge base article and CRM fields associated with the customer’s reason for contact, returning “not applicable” when neither source contains an answer.
Test Prompts
Before launch, Auto QA answers real interactions your evaluators already scored, side by side with their answers, question by question, until the two agree.
Predictive FCR
AmplifAI predicts first contact resolution for individual interactions, then validates the prediction against repeat contacts for a matching customer issue.
Customer Signals
AmplifAI analyzes calls, chats, emails, and social interactions to classify contact reasons, customer sentiment, interaction outcomes, churn risk, and agent behavior.
AI Assistant
Agents, team leaders, managers and analysts ask Max, AmplifAI's AI Assistant, performance questions in plain language from their dashboards, from KPI performance and trends to what is driving them, and get answers with the supporting data, calls and transcripts, without requesting a new report. Answers cover KPIs, interaction analytics, QA and performance data, scoped to the user's role, from an agent's scorecard to a manager's program.

AmplifAI Contact Center AI FAQ 
Frequently asked questions. 
Common questions about AmplifAI contact center AI software, AI readiness, next best actions, and how AmplifAI's AI compares to other contact center AI platforms. 
Is AmplifAI Right for Contact Centers That Haven't Started with AI Yet? 
Yes. Many contact center teams feel overwhelmed by scattered data and a lack of structure. AmplifAI begins by organizing your data, connecting it to the people and roles that need it, and turning it into actions one step at a time. AmplifAI does the work for you building the AI-ready foundation during implementation, so your team doesn't need everything figured out before getting started. 
Can AmplifAI Build Coaching and QA Structure from Scratch? 
Yes. AmplifAI builds structure around performance even if your contact center doesn't have centralized coaching or QA processes in place. AmplifAI's contact center AI software standardizes coaching, scales Auto QA, and creates consistency across teams and partners, all while using AI to accelerate what works best. 
How Is AmplifAI Different from Customer-Facing AI Tools Like Chatbots? 
Chatbots and other customer-facing AI tools are designed to interact with your customers. AmplifAI is employee-facing AI that supports and improves the people, and AI agents doing the work. AmplifAI identifies performance gaps, learns from high performers, and recommends next best actions for agents, coaches, and leaders. Learn more about the types of contact center AI software. 
Can AmplifAI's AI Be Aligned to Specific Business Priorities? 
Yes. AmplifAI uses a leadership-defined scorecard framework where you control which metrics matter most. AmplifAI uses those priorities to guide every recommendation, so the actions your managers and agents receive are always aligned to your goals. 
What Types of Contact Center AI Does AmplifAI Deliver? 
AmplifAI delivers leader-facing and agent-facing AI that runs on unified contact center data. AmplifAI's AI powers next best actions for coaching, quality management, performance tracking, recognition, and gamification. Every AI recommendation is driven by performance data from QA, WFM, CRM, CCaaS, and homegrown systems on one unified layer. Explore how different types of contact center AI compare in our contact center AI software guide. 
How Does AmplifAI Compare to Other Contact Center AI Software? 
AmplifAI is the only contact center AI software that unifies all structured and unstructured data including CCaaS, CRM, WFM, voice, chat, and surveys into a single AI-ready layer, then uses generative AI to deliver role-based next best actions across coaching, quality, recognition, and performance management. AmplifAI's AI recommendations are based on the full picture across every data source, every role, and capability. Explore detailed vendor comparisons in our contact center AI software guide. 
What Industries Does AmplifAI Support? 
AmplifAI powers contact centers across every industry with frontline customer-facing teams and AI agents. AmplifAI configures every AI capability including automated QA/QM, coaching, performance management, and CX intelligence to match each organization's data environment, compliance requirements, and business objectives during implementation. See how AmplifAI serves healthcare, financial services, retail and eCommerce, BPOs and outsourcers, hospitality and travel, and communications, media, and technology.

Trust, Security, and Compliance 
Quality and customer data handled to the standards regulated industries require. 
Visit the AmplifAI Trust and Compliance page 
Security at the data layer 
AmplifAI runs on internally hosted LLMs, so your data never touches public APIs and is never used to train models for other customers. Access is governed by SSO with Okta and Azure AD and role-based controls, so agents see only their own data, in a logically separated environment with no commingling between customers. 
AES-256 
encryption in transit and at rest 
Compliance at the core 
AmplifAI maintains the certifications highly regulated industries require, including healthcare and finance. Built on Microsoft Azure and working with AWS and GCP, it can be deployed inside your cloud infrastructure, with data region-locked to specific geographic locations.
